text:
Most visitors leave Osaka Station to find dinner. The best cheap eats in Umeda are inside the buildings around it: under the tracks, in the department-store basement and four floors down in the old Ekimae Buildings 👇

🦑 Bet you can't guess what Osaka's most famous station snack costs (it's less than a coffee) 👉 https://japanbystation.com/food-near-osaka-umeda-station

We checked every hour, price and closing day against official listings and kept only places rated 4★+ on Google Maps.

☕ BREAKFAST

Umeda Coffee-kan YC, 2 minutes from the gates, has served coffee and a Hatcho-miso katsu sando since 1968. Open 7:00 every day. Cash only.

🦑 SNACK

Hanshin's B1 ikayaki: squid pressed into a thin batter pancake, eaten standing. The shop has sold 10,000 in a single day.

🍜 WEEKDAY LUNCH

The Ekimae Building basements: big bowls at Udon Bou, set lunches at Iwamura. Many shops there shut on Sundays.

🍛 LATE

Spice curry at Kyu Yamu Tetsudo in LUCUA B2, 1 minute from the Central Exit, until 23:00.

🛒 And the supermarket right by the Eki Marché gate is open until 22:00.

👉 The 1950 alley the railway workers built, plus all 7 picks:
https://japanbystation.com/food-near-osaka-umeda-station
